---
name: Feature request / 功能建议
about: Describe a use case and the native DSH capability gap / 场景与原生能力缺口
---

## Use case / 使用场景

What are you trying to accomplish? / 希望完成什么？

## Existing capability / 现有能力

Which DSH-native or DSH-Bot feature did you try, and what is missing?
已尝试哪些 DSH 原生或插件功能，哪里不能满足？

## Proposed behavior / 建议行为

Describe the smallest useful change, scope, approvals and data boundaries.
说明最小有用改动、作用范围、审批与数据边界。

## Acceptance / 验收方式

A concrete example and expected outcome; distinguish mock/synthetic from real service evidence.
给出具体例子与预期，区分合成验证与真实服务效果。

Please avoid private data and credentials. Ongoing proactive work, IM, OS/mobile push and cloud hosting are not currently shipped features.
请勿包含私有数据或凭据；持续主动、IM、OS/手机推送和云托管目前尚未交付。
